probes.question: What did trade specialist Dr. Lena Cortez warn could happen as a result of the October 2023 tariffs?
probes.answer: Retaliatory measures that could spark trade wars and harm the very industries the policies aim to protect.
verbatim: critics, including international trade specialist Dr. Lena Cortez, have raised warnings about the potential for retaliatory measures, which could spark trade wars and harm the very industries these policies aim to protect.

probes.question: According to reports from November 2023, which two sectors did the government channel billions of dollars into?
probes.answer: The technology and renewable energy sectors.
verbatim: Reports from November 2023 revealed that the government channeled billions into the technology and renewable energy sectors, intending to carve out a leadership position globally.

probes.question: Why was Central Bank Governor Joshua Stein's hinted currency policy meant to boost exports?
probes.answer: By making exports more affordable on the international market through a weaker currency.
verbatim: Central Bank Governor Joshua Stein made headlines when he ostensibly hinted at adopting a weaker currency policy to boost exports by making them more affordable on the international market.

probes.question: On what date was the landmark IPR accord that has divided experts?
verbatim: The issue of intellectual property rights (IPR) has divided experts since the landmark IPR accord on November 12, 2023.

probes.question: What will the unfolding of 2024 be critical for, according to the document's conclusion?
probes.answer: Adjudicating the efficacy of the trade policies introduced in the post-September 2023 period.
verbatim: The unfolding of 2024 will be critical in adjudicating the efficacy of the trade policies introduced in the post-September 2023 period.
